ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Latinos, Labor, and Migration Description: This course will introduce students to how historians think about and do history, including the basics of historical research, the process of writing history, the theoretical perspectives used by historians today, and the implications of the digital turn in the researching and writing of history. Most importantly, we will read various types of primary sources, analyzing how historians have utilized them, and we also will do our own careful analyses of primary source texts. Throughout the semester, we will review and practice the methods historians use to illuminate the past.
